sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Surendra Kumar Chaubey,Ajay Kumar Yadav,Ray Sahab Yadav,Tapeshw
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajesh Kumar Verma Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 33 of 2022, under Sections 376(3), 452, 506 IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, 2012, P.S. Thariyaon, District Fatehpur, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

It was submitted that the sister of applicant is married with brother of victim lady and there was some matrimonial dispute between them and that sister of applicant has filed an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. and one case under Section 125 Cr.P.C. against her husband and that applicant has been falsely implicated in this case due to that reason.

The alleged incident has been shown of 19.11.2021 but at that time no report was lodged and later on the informant has moved an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. and FIR of this case was lodged in pursuance to the order of Court on 01.02.2022.

sentences.text: thus, she was a major girl.
The allegation that applicant has committed rape upon victim girl about two years prior to the lodging of FIR, is thoroughly false.
Similarly the allegation that applicant has prepared a video of victim girl, is also baseless.
During investigation no such video has been found or seized.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 02.02.2022, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.

Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the first informant have opposed the prayer for bail and argued that there is allegation that applicant has committed rape upon victim about two years back and at that time victim was a minor girl.

It was submitted that as the FIR of informant was not lodged by the police and thus, the informant has moved an application to Superintendent of Police on 24.11.2021 and later on she moved an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C.
It was submitted that the alleged case under Section 125 Cr.P.C. has been filed by sister of applicant after the incident.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant Bheem Singh involved in aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below subject to following conditions:
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
2.The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
3.The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

5.The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 A. Tripathi  Bheem Singh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51364358/
